title: Colourful
text: Informative, interesting, and with colourful stories from history of Seville and related cities and countries.
author: Jacobus_O

title: Magnificent
text: An absolutely exceptional experience from start to finish! Everything was perfectly organized, with a warm welcome and a high-quality service. We had an unforgettable time, rich in discoveries and emotions. It is exactly the kind of experience that makes a trip even more magical. I highly recommend it to anyone who wishes to experience a unique moment and leave with wonderful memories. A big thank you for this beautiful experience!

author: Chabela_L

title: Sevilla
text: Our tour guide was called Marta and she was excellent. We chose to take the Spanish speaking tour because my wife is Spanish and it was easy for me to translate as we went along. Marta was very knowledgable about the history of Sevilla and full of enthusiasm. She spoke clearly and loud enough for us all to hear.
author: James_H

title: Tour to do absolutely
text: A super pleasant walk with Marta as a guide. Marta is very friendly; she knew her subject and had plenty of amusing anecdotes. I recommend it
author: Maria_S

title: The tour guide & tour of...
text:
The tour guide & tour of the Santa Cruz was interesting & informative.
However, we & others who had booked, had expected to have a tour of inside the Cathedral with our booking. 
From the initial booking online, we were mislead into thinking that a tour of the interior of the Cathedral was included.
As there is a high demand for tickets to the Cathedral, Real Alcazar, etc., we were excited that the wording on the Viator site was offering a tour of the Cathedral.

I would recommend the tour, but it should be clear what people are booking.
author: Lily_C
